info.name: Bridge API
info.description:
Bridge provides an Open Banking API to initiate payments and aggregate financial data.  
Our API uses standards such as HTTP verbs, RESTful routing and JSON for payloads.

Contact Support:  
Name: BridgeAPI  
Email: [support@bridgeapi.io](https://mailto:support@bridgeapi.io)
